name: Rhapsody's Kalimdor Kocktail
summary: In the Hinterlands, Rhapsody Shindigger is ready to tell you what happened in the swamp, once he has a stiff drink. His Kalimdor Kocktail needs Roc gizzards from Tanaris and Groddoc and Ironfur livers from Feralas.

sections.title: A Stiff Drink
sections.body: Rhapsody greets Brohann's messenger with a hiccup. The two shared quite an adventure, but Rhapsody will tell you what happened in the swamp only after a stiff drink. The tale is not pretty. He has a recipe in mind: the Kalimdor Kocktail. Once it is brewed, he promises to tell you everything.

sections.title: Ingredients from Kalimdor
sections.body: Rhapsody needs three Roc gizzards from Tanaris, three Groddoc livers from Feralas, and three Ironfur livers from Feralas. Even his finest malt cannot help him face the memory of that fateful flight over the swamp.

faq.q: What does Rhapsody want for the Kalimdor Kocktail?
faq.answer: Rhapsody wants three Roc gizzards, three Groddoc livers, and three Ironfur livers for the Kalimdor Kocktail. He wants a stiff drink before telling you what happened in the swamp.

faq.q: Where do the ingredients come from?
faq.answer: The Roc gizzards come from Tanaris. The Groddoc and Ironfur livers come from Feralas.

faq.q: Who sent you to Rhapsody Shindigger?
faq.answer: Brohann sent you to Rhapsody Shindigger, who calls Brohann a crazy fool. Before that, Gryphon Master Talonaxe told you where to find Rhapsody.
